title: Esc menu
note: The suit menu over the running game (no pause), in the approved look (pages/suit-final, section 2, «Меню костюма (Esc)»): one tile, the tabs as text on the hairline strip with the small Esc keycap at its right, no page title under the tabs (the chosen tab names the page), small-capitals heads (ToyKicker) and hairline rows (ToySettingRow). Esc (ui_cancel) opens and closes it; the game runs on, the mouse is free while it is open and captured again on close. While it is open the own character takes no gameplay input (it stands still: no move, look, sprint, jump, interact or item use; those keys go to the menu or nowhere); the voice keeps working as set (voice activation, or the Talk key while held). Focus: the frames show the mouse's view with no focus drawn; ship-keys shows the ring keyboard and gamepad focus draws. The game boots straight into the ship (the engineer, 2026-10-21; s2 was removed): with no session the menu has Find a lobby (host, join with a code, join by address, the tutorial, quit) and Settings. The host's match settings are the ship console's screen (s4), so this menu has no Lobby tab. Open (each a visible placeholder here): the lobbies nearby and the own code (the target's list and «Твій код» row) need the game's network discovery and the engineer's words; the Guide's new topics (points, mutations, the neighbours' anger, the cops, the dead's room); every MVP task's card art (the art track's; own-work Delivery frames stand in here).

states.label: Корабель
states.note: In the ship with no session: the game boots straight here (the engineer, 2026-10-21) and every player returns here when a session ends or they leave it. Two tabs only, as the target page (pages/suit-final, section 2): Find a lobby (esc.tab.find, the Game tab's name while there is no session) and Settings; no Role, Guide, Character or Lobby tab without a session. The code field is empty, so Join is disabled. No control is drawn focused: the frames show the mouse's view (ship-keys shows the focus ring).

states.label: Корабель: поруч нікого

states.label: Корабель: код
states.note: Six valid characters typed into the code field, so Join is enabled.

states.label: З клавіатури
states.note: The same frame reached with the keyboard or a gamepad: Join has the focus and draws its focus ring. The one frame that documents the ring; every other frame shows the mouse's view, with no focus drawn.

states.label: Корабель: за адресою
states.note: Join by address pressed in the footer: the address entry takes the code entry's place, with the default port under it; Join, or host directly.

states.label: Персонаж
states.note: In the lobby (a session in the ship): the tabs Game, Guide, Character and Settings (Role is hidden in the lobby; the match settings are the ship console's screen, s4, not a tab here). The name and the body colour apply live.

states.label: Персонаж у раунді
states.note: In a round: locked; the name is read-only and the swatches take no input.

states.label: Гра: хост
states.note: In a round (the menu opens on Game there), the host: Leave and Quit open the confirm dialog.

states.label: Гра: гравець
states.note: In a round, a player: Leave and Quit act at once.

states.label: Гра: підтвердження
states.note: The host pressed Leave: the confirm dialog (P1) over the menu. Quit opens the same dialog titled esc.game.quit_confirm with Confirm esc.game.quit.

states.label: Роль: прибулець
states.note: In a round only: the own role and its goal.

states.label: Роль: людина
states.note: A human also sees the other humans (humans know each other: the engineer, 2026-10-20; one here, Zinga, as in s6 and s7); the list scrolls when it is longer than the view. With no other human the Team column is hidden.

states.label: Посібник
states.note: In a round: every how-to card, the basics from the tutorial and one card per MVP task type; Cooking selected. Its art is a placeholder (own-work Delivery frames) until the art track's cards exist; the card holds as many frames as its task needs and scrolls sideways.

states.note: Settings opens on Sound and voice. Drawn in the ship with no session, as the target page; in a session the same page sits under the session's tabs. Voice activation is selected, so the threshold row shows. The language is chosen only here, on Language.

states.label: Керування

states.label: Навчання

nodes.name: Dim
nodes.note: Dims the running game behind the menu.

nodes.name: Menu
nodes.note: One fixed size for every tab (1200x780, agent), so switching tabs never moves the tile: the target's 990 px wide tile holds its two tabs, a session's five tabs need more at large text, and Character's 456x608 preview sets the height.

children.name: Strip
children.note: ui-2.1.0 (the target page's .tabs): the tabs in one row on the strip, its 2 px edge line under them; the chosen tab light over the accent underline (ToyTabSelected); the small Esc keycap at the right closes the menu.

children.name: Tabs
children.note: One ButtonGroup; the selected tab shows its page. With no session (the ship): Find a lobby and Settings. In the lobby: Game, Guide, Character, Settings. In a round: Game, Role, Guide, Character, Settings. In the tutorial: Game, Guide, Settings. Default tab: Game (named Find a lobby with no session); the last tab is kept for the session. Opening the menu grabs no focus, so the mouse's view draws no ring: the first ui_left, ui_right, ui_up, ui_down or ui_focus_next grabs focus on the selected tab (keyboard and gamepad then draw the ring, ship-keys).

children.name: Game
children.note: One tab, two names: esc.tab.find («Знайти лобі», the engineer's word, 2026-10-22) while there is no session, esc.tab.game in a session; the game swaps the key when a session starts or ends.

children.name: Role
children.note: In a round only.

children.name: Guide
children.note: In a session only.

children.name: Character
children.note: In a session (not the tutorial); changes apply live in the lobby.

children.name: Gap
children.note: Pushes the Esc keycap to the right end of the strip.

children.name: Esc
children.note: The key that closes the menu, shown small (the target); its name is the bound key from the InputMap (data, not a copy key).

children.name: Page
children.note: The selected tab's page; no title row (the chosen tab already names the page).

children.name: Find
children.note: The Game page while there is no session, its tab named esc.tab.find, as the target page's «Знайти лобі»: the list area at the left, the code entry at its right, the footer row under the hairline. There is no server browser yet: Host makes a game with a code, the code entry takes a code, Join by address joins or hosts directly (LAN, VPN). The jobs of the removed start screen (s2, #111; prime-game#1285).

children.name: Body

children.name: Nearby
children.note: The lobbies nearby (the engineer, 2026-10-22: needed; the game's discovery is prime-game#1316), as the target's list (.lst): the head in small capitals, the rows, Join under them at the right. What "nearby" means (LAN discovery, public lobbies) is the game's; the list is the same either way. It refreshes while the tab is open; a lobby that goes away leaves its row.

children.name: Head
children.note: The tile head in small capitals (uppercase = true).

children.name: List
children.note: Rows 8 px apart; the first lobby found is chosen when the tab opens. A long list scrolls (a ScrollContainer at the page's height; three rows here).

children.name: Glorp
children.note: One row per lobby found nearby, built from the discovery's list (prime-game#1316): ToyPresetCard, a toggle in one ButtonGroup with the other rows; the chosen one draws ToyPresetCardSelected (the target's accent edge). Its content (no text of its own) is a row: the lobby's name, its players and the latency. A Button's minimum size does not follow its children: custom_minimum_size holds the row at 60 (the target's 40 x 1.5). Double click = Join.

children.name: Count
children.note: Players of the maximum (data, auto_translate_mode DISABLED), as the target's «6 / 10».

children.name: Ping

children.name: Zinga
children.note: As the first row, not chosen.

children.name: Count
children.note: Players of the maximum (data, auto_translate_mode DISABLED), as the target's «6 / 10».

children.name: Ping
children.note: The latency to the lobby's host, in whole ms.

children.name: Bulk
children.note: A full lobby: disabled (it cannot be chosen), its name dim and «Лобі заповнене.» in place of the players and the latency, as the target's muted row.

children.name: None
children.note: No lobby found nearby: one quiet line in the list's place, and no Join. It stays until a lobby appears.

children.name: Join
children.note: Joins the chosen lobby: s3 (the connecting steps). The target's filled Join under the list; the code entry's Join stays outlined. Disabled while no row is chosen.

children.name: Code

children.name: Head
children.note: The tile head in small capitals: the game sets uppercase = true on this Label (the pack's uppercase member).

children.name: Field
children.note: Empty until typed (ship). max_length 6; upper-cases as typed, drops spaces and dashes on paste, accepts only the 31-letter code alphabet (no 0, O, 1, I, L). Keeps what was typed after a failure (back from s3). Enter = Join when it is enabled. auto_translate_mode DISABLED. A click focuses it (the caret shows); the menu does not grab focus for it on open.

children.name: Join
children.note: The target's outlined Join. Disabled (unplugged) until the field holds 6 valid characters. Joins by the code: s3 finding. ship-keys: reached with the keyboard, it draws the focus ring.

children.name: Address
children.note: Join or host directly over ENet (LAN, VPN, playit.gg), in the code entry's place while Join by address is pressed. No address is shown anywhere else (streams).

children.name: Head
children.note: The tile head in small capitals (uppercase = true).

children.name: Field

children.name: Port

children.name: Foot

children.note: Your own code, to call friends into your ship (the target's «Твій код»). Whether every ship listens with a code while there is no session is the game's (prime-game#1316); while there is none, the three nodes hide.

children.name: CodeValue
children.note: The own code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); «…» while the code service has not made it yet.

children.name: Copy
children.note: Copies the code to the clipboard; the button reads esc.lobby.copied for 2 s (as on the session's Game page).

children.name: Host
children.note: Hosts a game with a code (WebRTC): the ship becomes the lobby (s4); the menu, opened again, shows the session's tabs; a failure shows s3 host-failed. The code is on the ship console (s4).

children.name: Direct
children.note: button_pressed while the address entry is open (the ghost's pressed StyleBox); pressing it again, Back or Esc (ui_cancel) closes it (Esc with nothing open closes the menu).

children.name: Tutorial

children.name: Gap

children.name: Settings
children.note: One scene (#301), the target's settings page: the section list at the left, the section's hairline rows at the right. The mic, the mode, the threshold with its live meter, noise suppression and the volumes work without a session. Saved per player.

children.name: Nav

Up and down move the focus through the list; ui_right moves it into the rows. 300 px holds «Звук і голос» and «Accessibility» at large text.

children.note: ToyMenuItem (the target's .nav item; a light-context variation since ui-2.2.0): dim idle text, the open section the pressed row fill with light text.

children.note: follow_focus = true, so keyboard and gamepad focus scrolls the focused row in view (the 15 keys of Controls, the volumes at large text). Spectating left the MVP (the dead wait in the dead's room), so its two keys are gone from Controls.

children.note: Hairline rows (ToySettingRow: the label at the left, the control at the row's right, a 2 px line under each), as the target's .sr; the pack has no zero-gap column, so 4 px stand between the rows. children.name: Bind
children.note: Button(ToyKeyButton), wide (min 96): its text is the bound key's label, DisplayServer.keyboard_get_label_from_physical() of the action's binding (data, auto_translate_mode DISABLED); Space and the mouse buttons use key.space, key.mouse_left, key.mouse_right. A click or ui_accept starts capture.

children.name: Bind
children.note: Capturing: settings.controls.press_key on the pressed look; idle it shows the bound key's label (E). A click or ui_accept starts capture: set toggle_mode = true and set_pressed_no_signal(true), which draws ToyKeyButton's pressed StyleBox (it has no toggle partner), and restore both when capture ends. Capture runs in _input and calls get_viewport().set_input_as_handled() on every event, so nothing else sees it: the next key or mouse button binds, except the release of the click that started capture, which is ignored; Esc cancels and is consumed (the menu stays open); the arrows and ui_accept do not move or press focus while capturing.

children.name: Same
children.note: Only on rows whose key clashes with another action of the same phase (here Map and Talk on M); give_up and ready share F legally (different phases, #211).

children.name: ResetGap
children.note: A spacer: 4 + 12 + 4 = 20 px between the last row and Reset.

children.name: Reset
children.note: Restores the default bindings. Esc itself is fixed.

children.name: Mode
children.note: One ButtonGroup: DisplayServer window mode.

children.name: Toggle
children.note: One ButtonGroup. On swaps GameUi's theme to game_theme_large.tres live.

children.name: Toggle
children.note: One ButtonGroup; the default comes from DisplayServer.accessibility_should_reduce_animation(). On: the connecting spinner (s3) turns at half speed; the pre and post game fades (s6, s10) and the End fade are cuts; the button press is instant (the pressed StyleBox still shows).

children.name: Choice
children.note: One ButtonGroup; each language is named in itself (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); the language applies at once (#208). A long list later would take ToyRadio rows.

children.name: Body

children.name: Resume
children.note: Closes the menu (as Esc).

children.name: Quit
children.note: The host: opens the confirm dialog (esc.game.quit_confirm, Confirm esc.game.quit). A player, and in the tutorial: quits at once.

children.name: Role
children.note: Reads only the own role and, for a human, the other humans.

children.name: You
children.note: A small-capitals head (uppercase = true) over the own side.

children.name: Role
children.note: The own side at the display size: ToyDisplayOnLight (the accent) with role.alien, ToyDisplayAlertOnLight (the danger colour) with role.human, as in s6 and s7.

children.name: Count
children.note: The number of the other humans (here one, Zinga, as in s6 and s7). A small-capitals head (uppercase = true).

children.name: Scroll
children.note: The view is 375 px tall; the list scrolls when it is longer.

children.name: Rows
children.note: One hairline row per other human, in join order; a long list scrolls in the 375 px view.

children.name: Name
children.note: The other human's name (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); a long name is cut with an ellipsis.

children.note: Fills the page height. follow_focus = true, so keyboard and gamepad focus scrolls the topic in view. 360 px holds the longest topic at large text.

children.name: V
children.note: One ButtonGroup over every topic, drawn as the settings' section list (the open topic shows the pressed row fill); a topic shows its card, headed with the topic's name. The MVP's new topics (points, mutations, the neighbours' anger, the cops, the dead's room) are open: their texts and cards are the engineer's.

children.name: Basics
children.note: A small-capitals head (uppercase = true).

children.name: Moving
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.move.title, .pick_up.title, .put_down.title, .hand_belt.title.

children.name: Voice
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.voice.title, tutorial.step.voice.how, tutorial.list.death.

children.name: Downed
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.downed.title, downed.give_up_hold, then the death frames: tutorial.step.dead_room.title, tutorial.step.dead_room.how (drafts; the dead wait in the dead's room, m8 §3).

children.name: Gap
children.note: A spacer: 4 + 16 + 4 = 24 px between the Downed row and the Tasks head.

children.name: Tasks
children.note: A small-capitals head (uppercase = true).

children.name: CarTuning
children.note: The MVP's five task types (GDD §8, #1144), in the deck's order. Each card needs new wordless art (the card art quality bar); until the art track's cards exist every card shows the placeholder (own-work Delivery frames, dist/pack/cards/).

children.name: Card
children.note: P8's how-to card without its own panel inside the menu's tile (the target draws no tile in a tile): the head, then the frames in one row that scroll sideways, as in s3 and s8, with 272 px art beside the topic list. A card is content data per task type (#254).

children.name: Head
children.note: The card's head as in s3 and s8: howto.label in small capitals over the open topic's name, so the card is the same in s3, s5 and s8.

children.name: Note
children.note: The game sets uppercase = true.

children.name: Title
children.note: The open topic's name (a basics topic shows its guide.* name).

children.name: Scroll
children.note: The frames scroll sideways when they do not fit (the engineer, 2026-10-22): a card holds as many frames as its task needs. No bar is drawn (SCROLL_MODE_SHOW_NEVER) until the pack has a sideways bar; the frame cut at the card's edge shows there is more. The wheel scrolls it sideways while vertical scrolling is disabled, a drag on a touch screen too (unconfirmed for Godot 4.7.2: check ScrollContainer's wheel handling); follow_focus true. Here the view fills the card beside the topic list (at least one frame, 302 px).

children.name: Art
children.note: PLACEHOLDER art: seven own-work Delivery frames (dist/pack/cards/delivery-meaning-1..3, delivery-1..3 and delivery-meaning-4, 640x480, transparent) stand in for the Cooking card's seven frames, which the engineer named every card's placeholder (2026-10-22). Those frames are generated art kept in the art track (prime-game-art#272) and this repo's licence list does not cover generated art yet, so the game takes them from the art track's pack. expand_mode IGNORE_272x204 here, 352x264 in s3 and s8, stretch_mode KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED; SIZE here; the same card in s3, s5 and s8. The cards are wordless: a frame holds only its art, no caption.

children.name: Frame7
children.note: The frame that shows the finish.

children.name: Preview
children.note: In the game: SubViewportContainer (stretch true) · min 456×608 with a SubViewport showing the own character; the page draws a ToyHowtoFrame placeholder.

children.name: Form

children.name: Field
children.note: The player's name, kept between sessions; auto_translate_mode DISABLED. editable false in a round.

children.name: Swatches
children.note: The ten body colours (#255; the palette is not decided yet).

children.name: Swatch1
children.note: In the game: TextureButton · toggle_mode · one ButtonGroup · 60×60 (focus_mode ALL in the lobby, NONE in a round; mouse_filter IGNORE in a round). The disc is tinted with the body colour (content data, #255; the page's colours are samples only). Keyboard and gamepad focus shows ToySwatchFocus, a Panel over the swatch (mouse_filter IGNORE), visible while it has focus; the frames show the mouse's view, so no swatch is drawn focused.

children.name: Disc
children.note: self_modulate = the body colour (content data).

children.name: Ring
children.note: mouse_filter IGNORE.

children.name: Sel

nodes.name: ConfirmDim
nodes.note: mouse_filter STOP: blocks the mouse to the menu behind while the dialog is open. Keyboard and gamepad focus search ignores what is drawn on top, so while the dialog is open set focus_behavior_recursive = FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_DISABLED on Menu (Control, Godot 4.5+) and restore FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_INHERITED on close. The dialog handles ui_cancel itself (= Cancel) and calls get_viewport().set_input_as_handled(), so Esc closes only the dialog, not the menu too.

nodes.name: Confirm
nodes.note: P1. Opened by the host's Leave (esc.game.leave_confirm, Confirm esc.game.leave) or Quit (esc.game.quit_confirm, Confirm esc.game.quit). ui_cancel = Cancel.

children.name: ConfirmButton
children.note: Ends the session for every player; everyone returns to their own ship (Quit: quits the game).

children.name: Cancel
children.note: Takes focus when the dialog was opened with the keyboard or a gamepad (it then draws the ring); opened with the mouse, nothing grabs focus. Closes the dialog.
